params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: request  Priority: P3
Summary: Trendwolves editorial sent eight new external reports to be read into the Observatory as report signals.

The reports (PDF):

- The certainty economy: China's Gen Z (Accenture Chinese Consumer Insights), 11 pages
- Gen Z Wallet (Dentsu), 7 pages
- Gen Z & Gaming audience report (GFB & GWI, September 2026), 35 pages
- Megatrends, 20 pages
- Beauty perspectives report 2026 (IFOP group x Strategies), 19 pages
- Connecting the dots 2026 (GWI), 17 MB
- Does Gen Z really exist, 20 pages
- Second-hand culture, phone-free events, 3.8 MB

No code change: they go in through the Reports page of the Observatory (POST /upload-report, then ingest-report). Before uploading, check that none is already on the shelf, and that the terms of each publisher allow use in a paid product. The download links in the mail expire on 19 November 2026; a copy is kept on the workbench.

Source: Portal mail:23.
params.title: Read eight new external reports into the Observatory
